She also says Senator Susan Collins’ opposition to Todd Blanche’s nomination for attorney general reflects the political need to distance herself from President Trump as she enters what Taylor calls her most vulnerable reelection position yet. title: Saudi Arabia Tries Diplomacy to Stop Houthi Attacks Growing
title_cn: 沙特阿拉伯尝试通过外交手段阻止胡塞武装袭击升级
summary: Saudi Arabia wants to contain a renewed conflict with Houthi militants through behind-the-scenes diplomacy, according to people familiar with the matter, in a bid to prevent clashes with the Iran-backed group hurting its oil industry and economy.

title: Fuel Shipping Waiver Extension ‘Quite Likely,’ Energy Chief Says
title_cn: 能源主管表示，燃料运输豁免“很有可能”延长
summary: Trump administration officials are moving toward granting another temporary extension of a waiver of a century-old shipping law that made it easier to move oil, fuel and fertilizer around the US, the nation’s energy chief said Tuesday.
